title: 5 Minute Meditations For Kids- A Mindfulness Podcast For Kids
author: 5 Minute Meditation
description: 5 Minute Meditations for Kids is the go-to podcast for calming kids’ minds, boosting their confidence, and building emotional resilience—one short episode at a time. Designed for children ages 4–12, each 5-minute guided meditation features mindfulness exercises, breathing techniques, and positive affirmations that help kids feel calm, focused, and empowered—whether it’s before school, at bedtime, or during a moment of anxiety.
